decisions.rationale: Smallest fit within 70 minutes: provide the FastAPI Dockerfile skeleton and the Compose service, database and named-volume stanzas in the increment-2 scaffold, with clearly marked learner TODOs limited to the concepts the embedded steps teach (healthcheck, 0.0.0.0 bind, database per service). Alternatively add minuted worked-example-and-check steps for the Dockerfile and Compose extension before the build, and rebalance. Validation stays daemon-free (approved Q4b).

Keep the frozen environment-variable objective. Make the FT21 credential a clearly labelled disposable local-development value; require any env file to be excluded from version control, with a public test that fails if the env file is tracked; and state that this is configuration wiring, not production secret protection. Name Compose secrets as the production practice, as a pointer only, without adding a new objective.
